mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which compresses discount rates and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1% (measured at t-1mo), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals accelerating labor market deterioration, which is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises >0.3pp in a month, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production below 105 and a monthly decline in payrolls exceeding 0.5% signals an economic contraction, which is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 105 and PAYEMS declines > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 105 and PAYEMS declines >0.5% in a month, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-pandemic recovery phase, housing starts above 1000 thousand units signal strengthening consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances during the post-pandemic recovery period when HOUST is above 1000, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 105 indicates strengthening economic activity, which is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 105, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the consumer price index exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals rising inflation, which is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises >0.2pp in a month, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real sales above 0.5% and a decline in the federal funds rate below 0.1% signals strong consumer demand and accommodative monetary policy, which together drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS rises > 0.5% in 1 month and FEDFUNDS falls > 0.1pp in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS rises >0.5% and FEDFUNDS falls >0.1pp in a month, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate below 6.0% signals improving labor market conditions, which is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls below 6.0% during a high unemployment regime (UNRATE>6.0% at t-1mo), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.
